summary.text: Steve Wicklund is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Maria Elena Bisabarros (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Wicklund described himself as Village President of Union Grove and the owner of BSW Electric, an electrical contracting company.

paragraphs.text: Wicklund said in the Ballotpedia survey that he is Village President of Union Grove, chair of the Racine County Intergovernmental Cooperation Council, and owner of BSW Electric, which he said employs 11 people.
He said he has led the village since 2021 and has been elected Village President three times.
Wicklund advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary, defeating Rick Stacey 54.5 percent to 45.5 percent.
Wicklund said his priorities include protecting taxpayers, balanced budgets, local control, workforce development, reducing regulations and expanding apprenticeships and technical education.
He listed endorsements from the Wisconsin Realtors Association, Senator Wanggaard, Rep. Nedweski and Rep. Wittke.
